settings.text:
Holding warm Himalayan salt...
allows beneficial negative ions to enter the body.

Like walking barefoot on the beach (where negative ions have a grounding effect) holding a hot Himalayan salt ball also has a grounding effect.

And the results are similar.
Negative ions can have a calming and anti-inflammatory effect - the reason we feel great at the beach!

Users report feeling relief from

  • Arthritis
  • Anxiety
  • Sore, tight muscles
  • Stiff neck (“tech neck”)
  • Tremors
  • Inflammation

settings.title: Negative Ions
settings.text:
When properly heated, Himalayan salt lamps emit negative ions up to 4 feet around the surface area of the lamp.
The negative ions neutralize positive ions in the air such as:

  • Allergens
  • EMFS
  • Virus & Bacteria
  • Odors
  • Mold & Mildew

settings.title: How They Work
settings.text:
Salt naturally attracts moisture from the air.
When the salt is warm, the moisture evaporates.
This action causes negative ions to be released into the air.
Your salt lamp must have an incandescent light bulb to create the necessary heat.

settings.title: A Calming Effect
settings.text:
Negative ions are why the air is so amazing after a thunderstorm and why we feel calm and relaxed at the beach.

Best Places for a Salt Lamp are:

  • Next to a computer
  • Where you watch TV
  • Nightstand
  • By a favorite chair
  • Kitchen table
  • Child’s room
  • Pet area
